messages:
anya: Heads up - we're seeing a p99 latency spike on hosted-rt gpu pool starting ~11:15 UTC, ~2x baseline. Not across all hosts, concentrated on vm-rt-7..9.
miguel: Seen it too, looks like small-seq (<64) requests are hitting a different GEMM kernel after yesterday's driver/optimizer rollout.
kevin: Any errors in logs? OOMs or cuBLAS fallbacks?
anya: No OOMs. Trace shows a switch from tiled_gemm_v2 -> generic_gemm_v1 around the spike timeframe.
linda: That's the new tiling heuristic we enabled in canary for cuda12.4. Could be regression.
ops-bot: deploy:infra/driver-upgrade to cuda-12.4 completed 2026-03-17T23:40:02Z by infra-ops
anya: Nice catch @ops-bot. miguel can you share perf profile snippet?
miguel: Pasting hotlines: ```
# profile excerpt
seq_len=32 samples=150
kernel: tiled_gemm_v2  time_avg=0.9ms  p95=1.8ms
kernel: generic_gemm_v1 time_avg=3.6ms  p95=7.2ms
```
kevin: That's huge for short seqs. Batcher expects tiled kernel for latency SLOs. Why are we routing to generic?
miguel: Kernel selector logs show heuristic: "workspace_est > threshold" for 32-> chose generic. Workspace estimator seems inflated on those hosts.
linda: Could be driver-level reported free memory diff after driver update, making estimator think tiled doesn't fit. Any signs of noisy neighbor?
anya: Host metrics show sporadic GPU memory pressure on vm-rt-8 around spike times — processes unrelated (ML training) on co-located VMs. Noisy tenant.
kevin: So selector sees less available workspace -> picks generic fallback. That explains consistent slow p99.
anya: Quick mitigation: pin heuristic to prefer tiled_gemm_v2 for seq<64 on hosted-rt pools while we investigate. Can we push a config?
miguel: I can push a quick override to runtime config: ```
selector.tiling.force_shortseq=1
``` and roll to canary then prod.
linda: +1. Also add a guard to ignore transient workspace reports older than 10s to avoid thrash.
tracebot: trace: created span 0a3f... for request 0x1337 - kernel choice generic_gemm_v1 - duration 6.8ms
kevin: Post-mitigation plan: 1) roll override 2) repro on a repro host (vm-rt-8) with synthetic noisy memory pressure 3) file bug with driver team if workspace calc differs under cuda12.4
anya: I'll kick off the config override now and monitor p99.
ops-bot: config:runtime selector.tiling.force_shortseq updated by miguel - rollout started
miguel: Canary looks good, p99 back to baseline on canary hosts. Rolling to 80%.
linda: Great. Please collect a detailed diff of workspace probe readings before/after upgrade. We need to correlate driver reports -> estimator values.
kevin: Also capture kernel launch params and workspace sizes to make sure our estimator math is consistent with driver allocator.
anya: Filing followup ticket with notes + linking traces. Thanks everyone for quick triage.
miguel: Filed: INF-4321 "GEMM selector workspace regression after cuda12.4 -> tiling fallback for short seqs" with repro steps and collected traces.
anya: Marking incident resolved for now after rollout; leaving ticket open for root cause. :white_check_mark:
